description: Common limit and ordering controls for an opt-in delivery-reporting dimension.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return. Defaults to 25.

sort_by.description: Metric used to order rows. Falls back to spend when unavailable at this row grain; on fallback sort_direction resets to desc. Rows lacking a value for the applied sort metric order last regardless of direction.
sort_by.title: Sort Metric

sort_direction.description: Direction for sort_by ordering. Sellers MUST apply the requested direction to the applied sort metric; direction has no availability fallback.
sort_direction.title: Sort Direction
